Our story

A neighbourhood café
with a roastery in the back.

Daybreak started as a coffee cart outside the station. Ten years later we roast our own beans, bake everything in-house and still know most of our regulars by their order.

No laptops-only rule, no rush – just good coffee, honest food and a warm room.

Opening hours

Good to know

Before you come.

Can I bring my laptop?

Of course – just share the big table at lunchtime.

Are dogs welcome?

Yes, with water bowls and biscuits behind the bar.

Do you take bookings?

Not for tables – only for the back room and events.

Is there parking?

Temple Gate car park is a three-minute walk away.
